points.statement: Multi-head linear attention is used to model the relationship between these features.
points.quote: We utilize multi-head linear attention to effectively model the relationship between these features.

points.statement: Fused features are combined with the input to create a grouping-mask that clusters regions by spatial similarity and image texture.
points.quote: The fused features are integrated with the input to generate a grouping-mask that clusters regions based on the spatial similarity and image texture.

points.statement: A group-wise attention mechanism is introduced to use the mask for robust adverse weather removal and consistent performance across diverse weather conditions.
points.quote: To fully leverage this mask, we introduce a group-wise attention mechanism, enabling robust adverse weather removal and ensuring consistent performance across diverse weather conditions.

points.statement: Fused features detect degradation patterns and create a grouping-mask for spatial grouping.
points.quote: The fused features identify degradation patterns and generate a “grouping-mask” for spatial grouping.

points.statement: The mask groups features for group-wise spatial and channel attention.
points.quote: Features are grouped by the mask for group-wise spatial/channel attention.

points.statement: Information exchange is expanded beyond local spectral regions by comparing spatially similar areas, enabling broader degradation-aware feature sharing and efficient grouping.
points.quote: Building on this, we expand the information exchange beyond local spectral regions by identifying and comparing spatially similar areas across the image, facilitating broader degradation-aware feature sharing and more efficient grouping.

points.statement: Group-wise attention is applied spatially and across channels, allowing the model to focus on relevant features.
points.quote: These group-wise attention is applied both spatially and across channels, allowing the model to focus on the most relevant features.

points.statement: The proposed architecture enables robust degradation removal across diverse adverse weather conditions.
points.quote: Consequently, our proposed architecture enables robust degradation removal across diverse adverse weather conditions.

points.statement: A specialized architecture is designed to use grouped features and facilitate global information exchange by optimizing their integration.
points.quote: To effectively utilize these grouped features and facilitate global information exchange, we design a specialized architecture tailored to optimize their integration.

points.statement: An effective solution is required that extracts valuable spectral information for frequency-based image restoration while preserving spatial details to avoid losing contextual information.
points.quote: Therefore, an effective solution is required that extracts valuable spectral information for frequency-based image restoration, while preserving spatial details to prevent the loss of crucial contextual information.
